name: Curiosity Question Cartoon
description: A bright simple cartoon moment with a truthful short curiosity hook.
composition_guidance: Build one instantly readable cartoon situation: one oversized subject, optionally one reacting guide or reveal object, and a visible tension.
required_elements: one oversized primary subject or creature
one emotionally clear reveal, contrast, or reaction
avoid_elements: the full episode title, paragraphs, labels, or dense infographic
more than two competing main subjects
generic bait, fabricated facts, copied characters, logos, or trade dress
small lettering, placeholder text, or post-render overlay
headline_guidance: Write one truthful 1–4 word hook about the actual subject or tension. Never use empty bait.
visual_style_guidance: Original 2D waxy-outline cartoon with wobbly crayon-marker contours, flat saturated blocks, expressive eyes, simple rounded objects, minimal shading, and no copied branding.
